description: Territoires à Risque d’Inondation important (TRI BASSE-TERRE) - Zone d'iso classe de hauteur is a dataset listed in Geocatalogue France, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by BUREAU DE RECHERCHES GÉOLOGIQUES ET MINIÈRES. An area for which a hazard of a certain type under a certain scenario causes a rise of water whose height is within a fixed range of values. A height class iso area is an area for which all water heights are within the same height range. Coverage: FR. The portal shows the English title as "Territories at significant flood risk (TRI BASSE-TERRE) — Iso zone height class" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include TRI, Directive inondation, Zones à risques naturelles. The listing shows 2020-03-31 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-geocatalogue-fr.
